Question: what are the orders for namaz in kasar?We have to performe the sunnate alsoduring kasar?we are having a home in Deoband but we reside in Delhi and the home is at rent.Now if our whole family go there for holidays at our relatives and not at our home then alsowe have to perform the of kasar?Plz rep in the light of hadis and kuran with their tarjuma! Answer ID: 25475 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1560/10012/L=1431) It is better to offer the sunnah salah in journey if one feels comfortable. If one does not feel comfortable and is in hurry, he can offer the fardh and wajib only and leave the sunnah. If you are going to the house of your relatives, and their house is situated at the distance of 77.25 km or more, and you do not intend to stay there for fifteen days, then you should do qasr there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
